description: This file contains asynchronous functions to fetch image details from URLs, using various HTTP clients (custom HTTPHandler, aiohttp). It includes testing functions to compare performance of different async methods for HTTP requests, and a main execution block that runs these tests and reports timing statistics.

methods.name: asyncify(func, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Runs a blocking function asynchronously in a separate thread

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] get_image_details(image_url)
methods.description: Fetches image data synchronously using custom HTTPHandler, extracts content type and encodes image content to base64

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] get_image_details_async(image_url)
methods.description: Fetches image data asynchronously with AsyncHTTPHandler, processes response similarly

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] get_image_details_aio(image_url)
methods.description: Fetches image data asynchronously with aiohttp, processes response similarly

methods.name: list[float] test_asyncified(urls: list[str], iterations: int = 3)
methods.description: Runs multiple iterations of get_image_details in parallel and measures time

methods.name: list[float] test_async_httpx(urls: list[str], iterations: int = 3)
methods.description: Runs multiple iterations of get_image_details_async in parallel and measures time

methods.name: list[float] test_aiohttp(urls: list[str], iterations: int = 3)
methods.description: Runs multiple iterations of get_image_details_aio in parallel and measures time

methods.name: run_comparison()
methods.description: Executes performance tests for different async HTTP methods on a set of image URLs and prints timing statistics
